name: @w6w-apps/facebook
description: Manage Facebook Pages, posts, comments, photos, videos, insights and basic ad-account reads via the Graph API.

w6w.longDescription:
This app manages a Facebook Page day to day: reading and publishing posts, moderating comments, uploading photos and listing videos, and pulling Page-level performance insights — the everyday work of running a Page's presence rather than a personal profile. It also lists the Pages a connected account manages, so a workflow can enumerate everything it has access to before acting on a specific one.

It covers one narrow slice of Meta's advertising surface too: a read-only list of ad campaigns on a connected ad account, useful for reporting rather than for creating or managing ads. For Facebook Lead Ads specifically — a page's lead forms and the leads submitted through them — a separate, dedicated app in this pack covers that surface instead, so this one stays focused on general Page management: profile, content, and analytics.
